systems.system: Computerised issuance systems for national registration cards, passports and citizenship documentation
systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship (DNRPC), Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security, with Smart Zambia
systems.tiers: computerisation begun, announced 29 August 2025; online applications, including from the diaspora, once fully rolled out

note: The article describes computerising the issuance of identity cards, passports and citizenship documents, class identity. It does not mention birth or death registration, or any local office.
